description: For a learner building a real-time performance skill who cannot yet say accurately what they did at the moments that mattered, reviewing a recording against one stated focus, explaining paused moments, debriefing with someone who asks before telling and carrying one change into a recorded next attempt is expected to improve what they notice and their next performance, though no claim tests reviewing one's own recording against an alternative; the evidence is coaching reports, one study of teacher candidates analysing others' video, and findings carried from self-explanation and contingent support.
title: Video Replay Analysis
